purpose: OLP metadata-only scene-grouped PCAF external protocol
selection_guard: Eligibility and assignment use acquisition scenes, normal/anomaly availability, and stable hashes only; detector outputs are unavailable.

decision_rule_frozen_before_outputs.external_success: macro_delta_gt_0 AND textile_bootstrap_95pct_lower_gt_0 AND wins_ge_10_of_15 AND worst_delta_ge_minus_0.05

config.claim_boundary: External scene-grouped patterned-fabric validation on OLP front-light images; no roll or temporal claim. Eligibility and split are fixed from metadata before detector outputs.
